nodes.description: Address payable administrator of the delegator; set from msg.sender in constructor and later from admin_ parameter.
Address of the implementation contract that all delegatecalls target; controls all logic executed against this storage.
Address of the underlying EIP-20 asset wrapped by this cToken.
Comptroller contract that oversees inter-cToken operations.
Interest rate model contract used for borrow/supply rate computation.
Pending administrator awaiting acceptance via _acceptAdmin.

Admin-gated setter that replaces the implementation address and delegatecalls _becomeImplementation/_resignImplementation.

Internal helper performing raw delegatecall to a callee with arbitrary data and bubbling up reverts via assembly.
Public function that delegatecalls the stored implementation address with caller-supplied calldata.
Public view function that staticcalls itself with abi-encoded delegateToImplementation calldata to preserve the view context.
Payable fallback that requires msg.value == 0 and delegatecalls implementation with msg.data, copying and returning/reverting raw returndata.
External caller address; used as initial admin, as admin authorization check, and implicitly as the actor in the delegatecall fallback.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) inside delegateTo; executes arbitrary implementation code against delegator storage.
implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the fallback; forwards any calldata to the implementation with full storage control.
address(this).staticcall(...) used to route view calls through delegateToImplementation.
implementation_ address parameter of the constructor and _setImplementation.
allowResign flag deciding whether _resignImplementation is delegatecalled on the old implementation.
Encoded bytes passed to _becomeImplementation via delegatecall.
underlying_ address passed to the implementation initialize delegatecall.
admin_ address that becomes the final admin after initialization.

liquidator address parameter of seize, encoded into the delegatecall.
seizeTokens amount parameter of seize.
EIP20NonStandardInterface token address passed to sweepToken.
newPendingAdmin address passed through the _setPendingAdmin delegatecall.
callee address that delegateTo performs the raw delegatecall against.
raw bytes payload passed to delegateTo / delegateToImplementation.
Local cache of the previous implementation address used for the NewImplementation event.
Local bytes buffer holding delegatecall return data in the external wrapper functions.
Success boolean returned by the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
Raw returndata bytes from the delegatecall, bubbled up via assembly revert.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, giving the deployer temporary administrative power.
msg.sender determines the initial admin identity inside the constructor.
require(msg.sender == admin) gates who may change the implementation.
Stored admin is read and compared against msg.sender in the only access control check.
implementation_ parameter drives the privileged implementation replacement.
implementation_ is written into the implementation state variable.
oldImplementation local caches the previous implementation for the event.
Previous implementation value is read from state into the local variable.
Constructor delegatecalls the implementation initialize routine through delegateTo.
Constructor invokes _setImplementation to install the implementation.
_setImplementation delegatecalls _becomeImplementation/_resignImplementation on the implementation.
delegateToImplementation forwards execution into delegateTo.
Stored implementation address is used as the delegatecall target, so a re-set implementation changes behavior.
delegateTo executes the raw delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegatecall runs foreign code against this contract's storage where implementation lives.
Fallback forwards arbitrary msg.data to the implementation via delegatecall.
Fallback delegatecall target read from the implementation state variable.
View wrapper uses staticcall to route through delegateToImplementation.
mint passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher, enabling implementation-controlled execution.
redeem passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
redeemUnderlying passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
borrow passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
repayBorrow passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
repayBorrowBehalf passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
liquidateBorrow passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
transfer passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
transferFrom passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
approve passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
balanceOfUnderlying passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
totalBorrowsCurrent passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
borrowBalanceCurrent passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
exchangeRateCurrent passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
accrueInterest passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
seize passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher; the delegated seize uses msg.sender as the borrowing cToken.
sweepToken passes calldata into the delegatecall dispatcher.
allowance routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
balanceOf routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
getAccountSnapshot routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
borrowRatePerBlock routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
supplyRatePerBlock routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
borrowBalanceStored routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
exchangeRateStored routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
getCash routes through the view delegatecall wrapper.
mintAmount is the sole user-controlled argument of mint.
mintAmount is ABI-encoded into the delegated calldata.
redeemTokens is ABI-encoded into the delegated calldata.
borrowAmount is ABI-encoded into the delegated calldata.
liquidator address flows into seize and ultimately the delegated seize.
seizeTokens amount flows into seize and the delegated seize.
token address flows into sweepToken and the delegated sweep.
newPendingAdmin is the privileged admin-transfer argument.
newPendingAdmin is ABI-encoded into the delegated admin calldata.
callee is the arbitrary target of the raw delegatecall.
data is the arbitrary calldata of the raw delegatecall.
Local data buffer stores the return of delegateToImplementation before abi.decode in wrappers.
success boolean captured from the low-level delegatecall.
returnData bytes captured from the delegatecall and bubbled up with assembly revert.
delegatecall output data flows into the assembly revert path.
Any external caller can hit the fallback, whose msg.data is delegatecalled into the implementation.
_setPendingAdmin delegates a privileged admin-changing call.
_setComptroller delegates a privileged comptroller-changing call.
_acceptAdmin delegates a privileged admin-acceptance call.
_setInterestRateModel delegates a privileged model-changing call.
underlying state is derived from the constructor initialization path.
underlying_ constructor argument is encoded into the initialize delegatecall.
admin_ constructor argument becomes the final admin, bypassing any ownership handoff check.
implementation_ constructor argument becomes both the initialization target and the delegated implementation.
allowResign flag controls whether privileged resignation logic is delegatecalled.
becomeImplementationData sets the storage of the newly installed implementation contract.

normalization_plan.reason: implementation_ exists only to feed the privileged implementation setter and constructor installation path.
allowResign is a boolean local flag consumed only inside _setImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is only encoded into the _becomeImplementation delegatecall.
underlying_ appears only in the constructor initialize encoding.
admin_ is only assigned to the admin state variable at the end of the constructor.
mintAmount is a transient calldata argument with no independent semantics.
redeemTokens is a transient calldata argument of redeem only.
borrowAmount is a transient calldata argument of borrow only.
liquidator is passed straight into the delegated seize call.
seizeTokens is passed straight into the delegated seize call.
token is the sole argument of sweepToken and has no other use.
newPendingAdmin is only forwarded to the delegated admin-transfer call.
callee is the immediate target consumed by the raw delegatecall helper.
data is the calldata payload forwarded into the delegatecall dispatcher.
oldImplementation is a short-lived cache used only inside _setImplementation for the event.
The data bytes buffer is purely the delegatecall returndata holder in the wrappers.
success is the immediate boolean result of the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
returnData is the immediate returndata buffer of the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
